source: University of Utah official 2010-11 and 2019-20 men's basketball year-by-year record books and official 2002 Gonzaga series preview; contemporaneous La Grande Evening Observer Dec 23 1938 p.4
source_locator: Utah 2010-11 season literal 'Dec. 23 Gonzaga W 50-29 Spokane, WA'; Utah 2019-20 literal '12/23 at Gonzaga W 50-29'; Utah 2002 official preview says first meeting 1938-12-23 Utah W50-29 in Spokane; Dec 23 1938 newspaper literal 'defeated Gonzaga university, 50 to 29, in a practice game last night'
notes: Utah first-party 1938-39 season game ledger includes this W among official 13-7; 2002 Utah series preview identifies this as first all-time matchup, next meeting only in 1962, outside expansion. Contemporary Dec23 press calls it 'practice game' but official university consistently counts it as a season result and formal opponent series; retain literal rather than silently recategorize exhibition. HOME derives expressly from 'at Gonzaga', not Spokane geography. Exact played date UNKNOWN because dated school books say Dec23 while Dec23 newspaper says 'last night' (possibly Dec22). No facility inferred.
